comment: Probably the most boring professor at this school. He lectures at you and makes you do excel in class and homework, but then the tests have nothing to do with excel. He is not very accessible as he only holds Zoom office hours once a week.

Dr. Soule is like if your dad actually could help you do your math homework. His lectures are straightforward and he basically will hold your hand through the homework if you ask him to. I'm not a business student but I have a great understanding of Excel now thanks to Soule. Definitely take him for 202 if you can!

Dr. Soule's forecasting class was my favorite econ elective. His lectures focused on teaching the material and then working through examples in R. The homework assignments in R were interesting and applicable to real-world problems. Dr. Soule was accessible outside of class via email and office hours. The material was challenging but rewarding.

Good professor. Classes are organized to be very lecture heavy. He is a sweet guy who genuinely loves what he teaches, but he has limited interaction. He will not know your name all year. The exam was curved 7%, questions were not representative of what we learned. That being said the class is not terribly difficult or demanding.

He is such a caring professor that genuinely wants his students to succeed and improve. He recognizes improvement and will take that into account when calculating your grades. I would say he is a tough grader and assigns a lot of homework that would take HOURS but the work is manageable. Don't buy the textbook and beware of easy pop quizzes.

Soule is a good guy who is your average college professor. He'll forget your name but doesn't care about grades more about learning so he's very generous in terms of partial credit. His class is excel based but it's very manageable. His exams are straightforward if you pay attention in class. Pop quizzes around every 2 weeks based on HW vids.

Dr. Soule is good. His class is all excel, his lectures are boring and repetitive but not too bad. There are long homework assignments due every week. A few pop quizzes but eaasy. A lot of busy work and new information but he is a good guy and will help you out! If you put in the effort you will do well in his class. Always get out early.

Easy to get a good grade if you take him. Entire class is based on excel and if you pay attention in class you'll be able to do the homework/tests because the problems are similar. However, it's veryyyyy hard not to zone out bc he's not enthusiastic so it gets boring. Rlly nice guy though, does lots of office hours, and generous w taking off points

Dr. Soule is super nice and accessible, but class was super vague. He's great with Excel and my skills definitely improved. He's the only Bstats prof that solely uses excel which is amazing! The reason for why we do things or what they mean is not clear. He's super nice and helpful, but I didn't really learn, more memorized. Very helpful though!!

Too vague. He never hits the target of what he's teaching and expects students to know things and be on the same page as him. Get ready to be bombed with statistics that he won't explain what is what.

Soule is a laid back professor and very accessible outside of the classroom. His classes usually end 15-20 minutes early and his lectures are usually organized and easy to follow. The weekly homework can be pretty long and tedious, but he offers zoom office hours every week to answer homework questions. One of the best bstats professors here

There's a hw assignment every week, but he has a zoom office hour in which he goes through pretty much all of it. He usually talks about his experience at Capital One, which helps connect the class material with the real business world. Class may get a little boring, but overall, his class is still better than the majority of bstat courses offered.

A teacher who genuinely cares about his students + is very accessible. Lots of long/hard homework, upwards of 10-12 hours spent on the 1 weekly assignment. Textbook is needed to know some hw problems, but class is more helpful for understanding than reading. Is willing to answer any questions you have + is such a nice guy

Soule was very responsive to a small class setting, customizing lectures, lessons, and assignments based on the interests of the people in the room. He was so accommodating, that he gave our working pros a chance to use their own fields for custom projects. Sometimes the Weekly homework felt tedious, but that seems to be more subject related.

Prof Soule is amazing. Im starting a business and this class was incredible. Soule brings a wealth of experience and is great at explaining how concepts of management are directly applicable to business. I added this class to an already full schedule. Dont let others scare you that subject requires hw. He is always available to help you succeed.

I had Prof Soule for Spring 2020. I knew nothing about the Operations at the time but as the class progressed I began to like like it. I am glad I took the class and will absolutely not hesitate to have him for another class. I loved how he was able to seamlessly transition from in class to online due to Covid 19.

Prof. Soule is an incredible professor! He seeks feedback from his students to fine tune each class to their needs. He seamlessly pivoted to a virtual setting due to COVID-19. His class was straight and to the point, and he did a great job tying it all back to practical applications.

I had very little interest in operations prior to this class. Professor Soule had to pivot completely to move online due to COVID and he did an AMAZING job. He was so thoughtful about how to share material in a way that respected how crazy life has become and keep things engaging. Learned a ton, and a fair grader. Reasonable assignments/workload.

Soule was fantastic! Really passionate about the content and offered extensive help to students outside the classroom. His class was originally structured for people in manufacturing but when we all said we were in service providing industries he pivoted the content immediately. He also made a seamless shift to online due to COVID!

Soule was great - he is clearly knowledgeable and passionate about Operations, and made sure his all of his content was timely and relevant. He found a way to make transitioning to an online format during COVID easy and often pretty fun. Would recommend.

Prof Soule was one of the best professors I've had in the MBA program. He adjusted well to remote learning forced by COVID-19 and he was always kind, available, and really cared about us learning. I really appreciated him seeking feedback and adjusting course as needed. Great professor!
Brings a ton of experience into the classroom. It makes the content more relatable. Great Prof!

Finance background had some exposure to operations in undergrad before taking his MBA level course. Professor Soule has a strong track record in real world experience for this subject and I learned a lot. We did simulations and were exposed to tools that I can leverage moving forward. He is truly invested in his students learning and development!

His class is pretty boring as the content itself is not fun. He has complicated assignments every week which take time to complete. Not a fun class but if you work it is possible to score points. His midterm and finals are usually MCQs and there is a group project.

Professor Soule is very helpful throughout the course, and he tries to make the class more creative and interactive by running several simulations. I personally learned a lot from his class that I think I could apply them to my future jobs. Definitely recommend you to take his class.
LOTS OF HW! Must be very attentive in class Very time-consuming class...

You can tell Professor Soule is a new professor. He can get lost in his lectures sometimes but if you actually pay attention during class, it's incredibly easy to get an 'A'. He has complicated(ish) problem sets due almost every week that are time-consuming. Advice: put away the laptop/phone and LISTEN! You'll learn a lot and do well in this class
